remarks: Welcome to 22 Courtland Avenue in the desirable cooperative community of Courtland Green, located on the Stamford/Darien border just minutes from shopping, restaurants, trains, I-95, & the fabulous Cove Beach. This open, spacious, renovated second floor end unit has the perfect layout for carefree living as well as easy entertaining. Enjoy your morning coffee or evening libations & BBQ on your own outdoor deck! This unit is especially inviting with its warm, hardwood floors. The Kitchen boasts the coveted white cabinets with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances (including a gas range), a stylish tile backsplash, & also offers a dining area. This Kitchen is perfectly situated between the deck & a wonderful, oversized, open space that makes a lovely dining room, light-filled living room, & an invaluable office. A spacious primary bedroom has the added perk of a large, walk-in closet. The Full Bathroom has a shower/tub combination, & granite countertops. This unit offers lots of closets/storage space, including an extra storage area in the shared lower level. The potential exists for installing an in unit washer/dryer, but there is also access to a coin operated laundry in the LL. An added perk is one reserved parking space & plenty of visitor parking for guests. Enjoy heat, hot water, taxes & grounds maintenance all included in the HOA fee. Owner is only responsible for the costs of gas cooking, electricity & cable/internet. Nothing to do but relax & enjoy!
